correctness.rationale: For the exact printed ETM-3D ODE and rho>=0, independently reconstructed A and N. For any SPD centered W, odd cubic C_W=u^TWN(u) would dominate the quadratic derivative at t u or -t u, so global strict negativity forces C_W≡0. Independently solved all seven cubic coefficients: W=diag(a,1,2-a) after positive scaling, 0<a<2. Computed M=(WA+A^T W)/2, its negative-definite principal-minor criterion, det M=-F(a,rho)/4, F(0,rho)=-10 and F(2,rho)=-4rho^2. Independent exact SymPy checks recovered disc_a(F)=120P and exactly two positive P roots in (2.188758,2.188759) and (3.355161,3.355162). Exact root counts: F(a,1) has two roots in (0,2), F(a,5/2) and F(a,4) have none; discriminant and nonvanishing endpoint signs extend the feasibility conclusion over all rho>0, separately checking rho=0. M≺0 implies dV/dt<=-c||u||^2, hence global exponential stability for every rho<rho*. Independently checked disc_x Q=12000P; Q has no real root at rho=0 or 1, two at 5/2, four at 4, so its first real double root is born at rho*. The equilibrium substitution y=5x/D,z=x(rho+x)/D satisfies f1=-x Q/D^2, f2=f3=0; resultant_x(Q,D)=-500(rho^2-5) prevents denominator degeneracy at rho*, while gcd_r(P,Q(0,r))=1 excludes x=0. Thus a distinct real equilibrium exists at rho*, preventing global attraction and proving sharpness. The source verifier was inspected; identities and root counts were independently recomputed in /mnt/data private work script rather than inferred from ALL_VERIFY_OK.
residual_risks: Independent proof uses source quartic Q as input but verifies its rational equilibrium parametrization and denominator resultant; no exhaustive classification beyond the initial nonnegative-parameter stability interval is claimed.
The original proof says strict centered quadratic only; translated or nonquadratic Lyapunov candidates are outside the certificate equivalence.
Full record Git tree enumeration and reconstruction were unavailable; every named scientific source file actually used was fetched by frozen-commit path and its blob SHA recorded.

value.rationale: The ETM-3D benchmark exhibits parameter-dependent bifurcations. Locating the exact first global-attractor loss is a motivated dynamical boundary: it upgrades the source’s numerical first saddle-node and global boundedness to an all-initial-condition exponential-stability theorem with sharp failure at an explicitly isolated algebraic parameter. The cubic-cancellation classification shows a nontrivial coincidence: the full class of globally strict centered quadratic certificates loses feasibility at the same value where nonzero equilibria first appear. That exact phase boundary and certificate rigidity are reusable for bifurcation/control comparisons and are neither a routine restatement of a general quadratic-energy criterion nor a merely numerical refinement.
residual_risks: Value is for this specific recent benchmark flow; no broader universality or stability statement for later parameter regimes is established.
The coincidence may be exceptional to the chosen linear coefficients and is not claimed to classify other quadratic systems.

scientific_limitations: Statement restricted to benchmark rho>=0 and initial regime; no post-first-saddle branch classification.
No classification of centered non-strict, translated, or nonquadratic Lyapunov functions.
